title: To buy or not to buy - Claude 100$ Subscription
author: Psychological-Arm42
selftext:
So it’s been about 1.5 months now of me solo developing my open-world dungeon crawler game. But I feel like progress is slow due to having to keep usage limits in mind (2x claude 20$, 1x Codex 20$) and having to switch claude accounts a lot.

I can’t leave claude working overnight either, it would just eat up usage limits.

At this pace, it would take a many more months before my game is ready for play testing. Should I buy claude Max 5x to speed up the development time? With that I suppose it would be released before the end of the year.

comments.author: Drunkendrakon6
comments.body: Why not? If you want to do it just do it.

replies.author: DuckAndQwack
replies.body: Not for everyone this one is the question about "am I want it?", for some it's also "do I can afford this?"

comments.author: Destituted
comments.body:
Claude x5 is plenty, barely hit limits and dabble in Fable 5.2 when necessary.  Opus 5.5 is so good with usage that I was able to just ditch my Codex $100 plan last week since I was using both until Opus 5.5.

edit: By plenty I mean plenty for me, I rarely do any graphic work with it and right now it's just touching up the last pieces, so that may be why it doesn't drain as fast as starting from the ground floor of the game.

replies.author: MichaelEmouse
replies.body: Tell me about Fable 5.2 when it comes to game dev. I'm using my usage limit to make a tool so I haven't tried it for game dev.

replies.author: LucidFir
replies.body: procedural race tracks with tunnels into underground caverns. Opus5.5 is awesome but it missed the jagged edges and missing textures twice, so i tried fable on the task and it got it done.

comments.author: Great_Teacher400
comments.body: Or do what I do and have 3-4 pro accounts and make an app to run them all together. Then use other ai for questions etc and relay tasks to your Claude hubb

replies.author: MichaelEmouse
replies.body: If you have 3-4 Pro accounts, you're getting close to $100. It seems like you might as well get the Max subscription and benefit from the larger 5-hour usage limit and getting to use half your usage on Fable.

comments.author: UndeadBulwark_
comments.body: Try Qwen Cloud first it has Qwen, GLM and DeepSeek all-in-one for 5 to 18 dollars with extra discount on yearly pricing this includes Image Gen, Video Gen, ASR and TTS

comments.author: MichaelEmouse
comments.body:
I'm also thinking about doing this.

  
Right now, with a Pro subscription, you get a taste of Fable 5.2. Use it. 

  
It's the most advanced publicly available AI in history for 100 bucks a month. Try it and see if it's worth it.

replies.author: Upbeat-Mail7201
replies.body: For 100$ you can use it for 10min or so sadly it's burning the subscription in a few minutes down

comments.author: DaedalusRaistlin
comments.body:
Personally, I went for it and I can't see myself going back to the regular subscription. I've had it for about 4 months now and the amount of work I can get done is great. 

Almost never get close to hitting the 5 hour limit, whereas I was constantly hitting it at the normal plan. And now I often have 2 or 3 tasks running in parallel - working on a game, my 3d pipeline, and my open source OS/VM, all at once. 

I mostly use Opus 5.5, I generally only use Fable when I'm getting close to the end of my weekly usage and want to use it all up. Fable feels like overkill for most things, Opus seems smart enough for everything I'm throwing at it. 

If my GitHub commit history is anything to go by, the last few months have been a huge jump in output for me. I'm completing many goals in my OS virtual machine (porting old games like Doom to it), have a working local image to 3d pipeline, have prototyped some 30 games, and am actively working on about 4 games (the ones that were the most fun.) 

So to me it seems worth it.

comments.author: hokutonoken19xx
comments.body: I think you answered your own question.

comments.author: EasyTarget973
comments.body: Claude x5 is alot, try it. If it doesn't work, x20 exists, but that takes ...a lot of effort to chew through (unless you're fable 5.2, then rip). If you're asking whether or not you should upgrade to get  shit done faster yes, you should. will you make money on it? likely no. Consider it fun.

comments.body: i have two ultra claude accounts and i still need more. But I work on a lot of things at the same time on three computers

comments.body: i’ve been thinking about this too. i’m using chatgpt plus and i can upgrade to pro for 5x usage, but it also costs 5x, so it’s not like i’m actually benefiting unless I actually max out usage

comments.body:
Your already there and wasting a ton of money with codex. Do it with confidence and pride, canceling codex that is.

And yes, get the claude max sub also.

comments.author: ckn
comments.body:
i think it is better than codex, but lately, there has been this weird refusal to follow instructions, apparently there is something in claudecode harness where claude is skipping mandatory pause-and-review steps, marking tasks complete without running tests, and continuing to execute tool calls even after the user explicitly types "stop" or rejects multiple tool prompts in a row.   

This keeps up and I'll be dropping my max 200 sub, my local qwen3 inference actually does what it is told to do.

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body:
long claude is over rated and fucks up even with tight setups / configs . U already answered ur question bit the bullet , check utilization and plan accordingly , you will also get $100 monthly or api usage , that can get u some serious tokens with sonnet.

Also be critically aware of what burns utilization.

comments.author: Funny_Barnacle1743
comments.body: Take if for 1 month, thats what I am doing, but in my case I was reaching limits of $20 too fast (and opus was only managing Sonnet and Gemini 3.8 agents), both 5 hours and weekly, since now it is the most intense implementation phase I need a lot work to do, so it makes sense to have 5x, after that during the testing phase you might get around with $20, but from what I see now, it will be hard going back to $20. I never reach 5 hour limits but I still reach weekly in 5-6 days (but it is nice to take some rest before the reset).
